title: SEC2: outbox_tick N+1 contact lookups
description: In kith-peer/src/lib.rs outbox_tick (lines 889-916), for each due outbox entry (up to 50 from get_due batch), a separate contact lookup is performed via get_by_peer_user_id. This is an N+1 pattern: one initial query returns 50 entries, then 50 individual contact queries follow. Optimization: batch contact lookups or pre-fetch contacts for the due entry peer_user_ids. Note: This is acceptable for Phase 1 (single user, small scale) but should be addressed before multi-mailbox delivery or higher concurrency.
